title: CEM Corporation
content: CEM Corporation is a U.S. laboratory equipment manufacturer with systems used in materials digestion, synthesis, and analytical sample preparation. Its microwave-based platforms support laboratory workflows relevant to aerogel R&D, QC, and precursor analysis where repeatable preparation and controlled processing are important. CEM is a suitable Equipment Materials entry for research groups building broader advanced-materials lab capability.
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
